verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships a documented Connector SDK (Python) for building custom connectors, a full REST API for programmatic account/pipeline management, and explicitly provides AI coding agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI) that add Connector SDK skills for natural-language connector development, directly serving AI-native builders. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality and broader language support beyond Python.
